title: Chapter 1401 - 15: Past Self, Present Self, Future Self
content:
Chapter 1401 - 15: Past Self, Present Self, Future Self

Chapter 1401: Chapter 15: Past Self, Present Self, Future Self

The infinite great destructive forces intertwine and merge, yet are completely under Lin Yuan’s control.

In the eyes of the Red Dust Immortals and Immortal Kings, this is the symbol of comprehending the Dao of Chaotic Origin Destruction.

To comprehend the Dao of Chaotic Origin Destruction, at least the pinnacle realm of the Red Dust Immortal is required, and to realize it? It’s essentially impossible without being an Immortal King.

In other words, is this newly ascended Red Dust Immortal already stepping into the realm of the Immortal King?

Newly ascended Red Dust Immortal?

Immortal King?

Two completely different titles.

Yet they appear on the same person.

"It’s actually an Immortal King?"

Many Red Dust Immortals looked at Lin Yuan in disbelief.

At the same time, they began to re-examine the past timeline of the Great Wilderness Origin World.

Directly observing Lin Yuan’s timeline is too obscure.

Moreover, being on the celestial path inherently suppresses the observation of timelines.

However, all the Red Dust Immortals have left avatar imprints in the Great Wilderness Origin World.

These avatar imprints usually lie dormant.

They awaken only when needed.

The Red Dust Immortals cannot directly observe Lin Yuan’s past timeline, but they can observe the past timeline of the beings in the Great Wilderness Origin World.

Thus obtaining a lot of information related to Lin Yuan.

"Indeed, he’s a newly ascended Red Dust Immortal."

"Emperor Tianyuan only entered the Great Emperor Realm two million years ago."

"Two million years, and he’s already entered the Immortal King realm?"

"It’s terrifying, how did he manage it."

"With such speed in cultivation, even the three Immortal Emperors can’t compare, right?"

The Red Dust Immortals whispered amongst themselves, their eyes showing incredulity as they gazed at Lin Yuan.

If it was merely an emergence of an Immortal King, they wouldn’t be so astounded.

Pinnacle Red Dust Immortals are only a step away from becoming Immortal Kings.

Given the cultivation environment of the celestial path, a new Immortal King could emerge at any time.

But Lin Yuan?

Only two million years ago, he entered the Great Emperor Realm.

And now he’s an Immortal King?

In truth, the Red Dust Immortals don’t know that Lin Yuan’s actual cultivation time is far less than two million years.

Calculated in full, it’s merely over a hundred thousand years.

Most of that time was spent in other dimensional spaces.

Without the optimal cultivation environment like the Great Wilderness Origin World, abundant with Immortal Substance.

...

Beneath the time life of the Great Wilderness Origin World, there’s a limit to lifespan.

Yet undeniably, its cultivation environment far exceeds other dimensional spaces.

The upper limit for Twelfth Layer life is also far higher than other dimensional spaces.

Those supreme emperors can compete with the Red Dust Immortals to a certain extent, what distinguishes them from the time life is simply the lack of experiencing the Time Cycle.

...

"Truly a monster."

The white-haired Immortal King looked at Lin Yuan, deeply shocked internally.

As a fellow Immortal King, he best understands how difficult it is to comprehend a certain Dao of Chaotic Origin.

Especially the Dao of Chaotic Origin Destruction, which excels in offense; its difficulty surpassing most Daos of Chaotic Origin.

"However, for an Immortal King to become an Immortal Emperor...it’s far more difficult than a Red Dust Immortal breaking through to an Immortal King."

The white-haired Immortal King thought silently, while the Red Dust Immortals think breaking through to an Immortal King is arduous, they don’t realize that from Immortal King to Immortal Emperor, it’s the truly insurmountable leap.

...

"So many Red Dust Immortals?" Lin Yuan looked at various Red Dust Immortals, thinking secretly.

At this moment, he sensed the presence of more than sixty Red Dust Immortals, knowing that in the Chaos Void, it corresponds to Thirteenth Layer time life.

More than sixty time lives? Only in special dimensions like the Milky Way dimension where many Thirteenth Layer forces congregate could so many time lives appear at once.

Even though the Origin World is special, capable of merging more time lives,

Using the example of the first Origin World and the second Origin World, a complete Great Destruction Cycle gives birth to at most twenty to thirty time lives.

"Is it related to the end of the celestial path?"

Lin Yuan glanced at that virtual world at the end of the celestial path.

The Immortal Substance that permeates the Great Wilderness Origin World originates from that virtual world.

The existence of the Immortal Substance makes the transition of power in the Great Wilderness Origin World far faster than in Chaos Void and other dimensional spaces.

An era in Chaotic Space is often marked by a Twelfth Layer being cultivating and advancing to Thirteenth Layer.

Occurring over tens of thousands to millions of Cosmic Eras.

Whereas in the Great Wilderness Origin World, an era is merely a million years, at most two million years.

Because the maximum lifespan of a Great Emperor is a million years, perhaps extended by consuming an Immortal elixir to live another million years.

Million years?

Several million Cosmic Eras?

The gap between them is nothing short of a chasm.

With more Great Emperor Realm experts, naturally, the number of Red Dust Immortals who’ve passed through the Time Cycle would increase.

As the number of Red Dust Immortals increases, the number of Second Realm Immortal Kings and Third Realm Immortal Emperors climbs as well.

...

"Hahaha, welcome Tianyuan to the celestial path."

The white-haired Immortal King took a step forward, appearing in front of Lin Yuan and smiled.

"Welcome Tianyuan to the celestial path."

The other two Immortal Kings shared the same sentiment, their expressions friendly.

Adding a Red Dust Immortal helps them approach the virtual world at the end of the celestial path.

Not to mention adding an Immortal King.

"Tianyuan, you can call me Reincarnation."

The white-haired Immortal King smiled and said, his title being Reincarnation Immortal King.

"I’m Bai Bin."

"I’m Wushen."

The other two Immortal Kings introduced themselves.

"Reincarnation, Bai Bin, Wushen." Lin Yuan returned the greeting.

These three Immortal Kings are Second Realm time lives, stronger than the Gray Ancestor in Chaos Void.

...

Lin Yuan chatted with the three Immortal Kings for a while before discussing the current situation of the celestial path.

"At the end of the celestial path, there are two hundred and thirteen Red Dust Immortals, fourteen Immortal Kings, adding Tianyuan, it’s likely fifteen."
